title: Dynamic Object Printing
author: Tom Fitch, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: OPEN PRINTING FORM / OPEN PRINTING JOB / CLOSE PRINTING JOB
Dynamic reuse of a single form object for multiple print roles
Programmatic object property assignment at print time (position, size, value)

historical_commentary.text: This note showcased 4D v12's then-new object-level printing model (OPEN PRINTING FORM plus Print object), which let developers reuse a handful of form objects to render arbitrarily complex, data-driven documents like catalogs — a genuinely powerful and still-functional classic-language technique. It remains valid today for classic-Design-Mode/4D-language print jobs, but for new development 4D now recommends 4D Write Pro (or 4D View Pro for tabular reports) for building complex, data-merged documents, since Write Pro offers more robust, higher-level document composition than object-by-object print-form manipulation.
related_updates: 4D Write Pro (introduced 4D v16) is now the recommended approach for rich, dynamic document generation
4D View Pro (introduced 4D v17-18) is preferred for complex tabular/report printing
